evidence.initialSetup: At-1 paid actual Dimensional Anchor Action7RP24->17, first prepared family D0, V/S/F, rank4 Abjuration spell legitimately acquired at Wizard7. Chosen specialization is Divination, so no Abjuration passive buffer. Concentration source deadline59.
evidence.actualSourceRule: PROTECTED DISSONANCE INTERFACE. The first cast of each different prepared matrix family during an encounter generates 0 BASE Dissonance. This exemption affects only base strain. Refrain and explicitly printed strain costs still apply; the suite disables generic Overcast and does not layer historical Burn onto Dissonance. Repeating a matrix family follows normal Refrain immediately. Preparing duplicates or differently modified copies of the same underlying spell never refreshes the exemption.

completeSubmittedFinding.requestedCorrection: Bind whether the actual Dimensional Anchor cast at-1 belongs to the encounter whose current history is supplied. If it does, include its actual family in matrixFamiliesUsed in all nine full actor sheets and mirrors. If an intervening legitimate encounter boundary resets that ledger, explicitly supply that boundary and its authority while retaining the spell lifetime and other actual history. Do not infer a free reset from time0, merely relabel the old first-use or grant a second exemption. Provide a later same-family check showing the correct outcome. No existing damage, RP, form or exile result needs to change for this clarification.
completeSubmittedFinding.scope: This concrete qualification was noticed while checking corrected full Anchor metadata; it was not one of the eight original findings. Absence of a stated encounter boundary prevents treating either history choice as conclusively established.

findings.selection: Same encounter. Record [dimensional-anchor] in all nine full supporting sheets; retain the first cast’s zero base Dissonance, paid RP17, previous name, Refrain0 and original concentration deadline59.
findings.why: Wizard engine/11 spends the first-family exemption within an encounter; engine/5 unifies duplicates. The supplied genuine-encounter definition does not make time0 a resource reset. No intervening legitimate boundary was supplied, and none is invented.
findings.mainAndBranchInterpretation: Each branch retains its independent-reset and explicit override semantics. Removing the current Anchor field in a branch does not silently remove the already disclosed paid casting record.
